calls.thesis: Kaplan: high-conviction but highest-risk name; personalized cancer vaccine passed phase 3 in Aug, full data Oct 24, earnings end of month; suggests waiting until after earnings to see what happens. Up 550% this year, still 60% below pandemic peak; joining Nasdaq-100.
calls.bull_case: 9 cancer trials with Merck; vaccine costs 'hundreds of dollars'; AI-accelerated discovery.
calls.bear_case: $700M quarterly revenue vs $800M loss; speculative, size small; post-earnings volatility.
